## Libraries

```{r, echo = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(reticulate)
library(markovchain)
library(diagram)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
set.seed(12345)
```


## Full Transition Matrix as One Big Markov Chain

```{r}
tmA <- read.csv('~/Coding/Data/Farm_Model/trans_matrix.csv', header = TRUE)
tma <- tmA %>% as.matrix()
tmA
```
## Creating Markov Chains for each Climate

```{r}

stateNames = c('w1', 'w2', 'w3', 'w4', 'w5')

c1m <- tma[1:5,1:5]
c2m <- tma[6:10,6:10]
c3m <- tma[11:15,11:15]
c4m <- tma[16:20,16:20]

row.names(c1m) <- stateNames;colnames(c1m) <- stateNames
row.names(c2m) <- stateNames;colnames(c2m) <- stateNames
row.names(c3m) <- stateNames;colnames(c3m) <- stateNames
row.names(c4m) <- stateNames;colnames(c4m) <- stateNames

plotmat(c1m, 
        lwd = 1, box.lwd = 2, 
        cex.txt = 0.8, 
        box.size = 0.1, 
        box.type = "circle", 
        box.prop = 0.5,
        box.col = "light blue",
        arr.length=.1,
        arr.width=.1,
        self.cex = .6,
        self.shifty = -.01,
        self.shiftx = .1,
        main = "Climate 1 Markov Chain")

c1mc <- new("markovchain", transitionMatrix=c1m, states = c('w1', 'w2', 'w3', 'w4', 'w5'),
             name="climate1")

c2mc <- new("markovchain", transitionMatrix=c2m, states = c('w1', 'w2', 'w3', 'w4', 'w5'),
             name="climate2")

c3mc <- new("markovchain", transitionMatrix=c3m, states = c('w1', 'w2', 'w3', 'w4', 'w5'),
             name="climate3")

c4mc <- new("markovchain", transitionMatrix=c4m, states = c('w1', 'w2', 'w3', 'w4', 'w5'),
             name="climate4")


```

## Setting the Probabilities for Each Climate

```{r}

probc1 <- 0.60
probc2 <- 0.25
probc3 <- 0.10
probc4 <- 0.05


start <- runif(1)

if(start < probc1){climate <- 'c1'}
if(start >= probc1 & start < probc1+probc2){climate <- 'c2'}
if(start >= probc1+probc2 & start < probc1+probc2+probc3){climate <- 'c3'}
if(start >= probc1+probc2+probc3){ climate <- 'c4'}

print('Climate is equal to:')
climate



```


## Code for Markov Chain Sequence



```{r}
climate_realizations <- c()
precips <- c()
iters <- 1000
year_length <- 25

for(i in 1:iters){
  
start <- runif(1)

if(start < probc1){climate <- 'c1'}
if(start >= probc1 & start < probc1+probc2){climate <- 'c2'}
if(start >= probc1+probc2 & start < probc1+probc2+probc3){climate <- 'c3'}
if(start >= probc1+probc2+probc3){ climate <- 'c4'}

climate_realizations <- c(climate_realizations,climate)

if(climate == 'c1'){
  seq <- rmarkovchain(n = year_length,object = c1mc)
}

if(climate == 'c2'){
  seq <- rmarkovchain(n = year_length,object = c2mc)
}

if(climate == 'c3'){
  seq <- rmarkovchain(n = year_length,object = c3mc)
}

if(climate == 'c4'){
  seq <- rmarkovchain(n = year_length,object = c4mc)
}

precips <- c(precips,seq)

}
```

#Organizing and Summarizing Climate Realizations and Precipcatiation Information

```{r}
cm_in <- 2.54 # 2.54
rainfall_days_perc <- 0.70 # Use 75%

w1p <- 5 *cm_in * rainfall_days_perc
w2p <- 15 *cm_in * rainfall_days_perc
w3p <- 30 *cm_in * rainfall_days_perc
w4p <- 45 *cm_in * rainfall_days_perc
w5p <- 60 *cm_in * rainfall_days_perc

precips <- gsub('w1',as.character(w1p),precips)
precips <- gsub('w2',as.character(w2p),precips)
precips <- gsub('w3',as.character(w3p),precips)
precips <- gsub('w4',as.character(w4p),precips)
precips <- gsub('w5',as.character(w5p),precips)


climate_realizations <- as.factor(climate_realizations)
summary(climate_realizations)
precips <- as.numeric(precips)
summary(precips)

precips_df <- matrix(precips, ncol = year_length , byrow = T)
precips_df <- cbind(as.matrix(climate_realizations),precips_df)
precips_df <- precips_df %>% as_tibble() %>% arrange(V1)
precips <- precips_df %>% select(-V1) %>% t %>% as.vector %>% as.numeric




```
## Repeating for Other Scenarios

```{r}
# Climate 1 Scenario


precips_c1 <- c()

for(i in 1:(iters*4*probc1)){
  
seq <- rmarkovchain(n = year_length,object = c1mc)


precips_c1 <- c(precips_c1,seq)

}

# Climate 2 Scenario


precips_c2 <- c()

for(i in 1:(iters*4*probc2)){
  
seq <- rmarkovchain(n = year_length,object = c2mc)


precips_c2 <- c(precips_c2,seq)

}

# Climate 3 Scenario


precips_c3 <- c()

for(i in 1:(iters*4*probc3)){
  
seq <- rmarkovchain(n = year_length,object = c3mc)


precips_c3 <- c(precips_c3,seq)

}

# Climate 4 Scenario


precips_c4 <- c()

for(i in 1:(iters*4*probc4)){
  
seq <- rmarkovchain(n = year_length,object = c4mc)


precips_c4 <- c(precips_c4,seq)

}




```

```{r}
# Outputting CSV for Python Run




precips_c1_tbl <- precips_c1_df %>% mutate( run = seq(1,nrow(precips_c1_df)) )%>% 
  pivot_longer(!run, names_to = 'year', names_prefix = 'V', values_to = 'precip')

precips_c2_tbl <- precips_c2_df %>% mutate( run = seq(1,nrow(precips_c2_df)) )%>% 
  pivot_longer(!run, names_to = 'year', names_prefix = 'V', values_to = 'precip')

precips_c3_tbl <- precips_c3_df %>% mutate( run = seq(1,nrow(precips_c3_df)) )%>% 
  pivot_longer(!run, names_to = 'year', names_prefix = 'V', values_to = 'precip')

precips_c4_tbl <- precips_c4_df %>% mutate( run = seq(1,nrow(precips_c4_df)) )%>% 
  pivot_longer(!run, names_to = 'year', names_prefix = 'V', values_to = 'precip')


precips_c0_tbl <- rbind(precips_c1_tbl, precips_c2_tbl, precips_c3_tbl, precips_c4_tbl)

precips_c0_tbl <- precips_c0_tbl %>% mutate(run = rep(seq(1,4000), each=25) )
```
